## Appearance

Harrison is short, fat, and bald, with a round face and prominent blue eyes. He presents a neat and snug appearance.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P11](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0011), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P8](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0008)_

## Personality

A crusty, crabbed, and lonesome old pipe-smoker, Harrison is known for an outspoken nature that he prides himself on, making him hard to please. Outwardly sympathetic and kind, he nevertheless dislikes being pitied and holds a prejudice against marriage. Though usually unconcerned with his appearance, he makes a point to wear a white collar during business deals so that looking prosperous deters others from trying to cheat him.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P49](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0049), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P76](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0076), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P78](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0078), +3 more_

## History

Before settling in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mr. Harrison was an old bachelor who had lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), having delayed marriage for a long time. His initial encounter with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was a fiery confrontation when he angrily accused her of letting her cow into his oat field. Shortly thereafter, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold Mr. Harrison's Jersey cow, but he took her mistake good-naturedly, accepted her cow in exchange, and invited her for tea. Despite his skepticism regarding her teaching methods and his refusal to donate to her Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society), the two forged a friendly acquaintance. During a devastating hailstorm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed. He eventually revealed to [Anne](../character/anne.md) that he and his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), had previously separated over his parrot and housecleaning habits; the couple subsequently reconciled, and [Emily](../character/emily.md) returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). ## Quotes

> “Who? Mrs. Lynde? Don’t you tell me I’m like that old gossip,” said Mr. Harrison irritably. “I’m not . . . not a bit. What have you got in that box?”
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P27](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0027)

> "I don’t, that’s a fact, and I’m mighty fond of it, too. I’m much obliged to you. It looks good on top. I hope it’s good all the way through."
>
> — Harrison — [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P29](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0029)

> "Well, I’ll tell you what, miss, you must help me eat it. I’ll put the kettle on and we’ll have a cup of tea. How will that do?"

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--harrison.md)

Harrison's relationship with [Anne](../character/anne.md) began on hostile terms when he angrily confronted her over a cow escaping into his oats. Their dynamic quickly smoothed over after [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold his cow, confessed her blunder with a baked cake, and offered her own cow as a replacement. The two subsequently developed a close friendship, frequently visiting and chatting together on his porch about neighborhood gossip and local events.

- Friend of — good friends who visit and chat in the evening  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P2](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0002)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--harrison.md)

Harrison and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) built a friendly neighborly bond following an initial mishap where [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally sold his Jersey cow. After she visited his home with a nut cake to apologize and replace the animal, Harrison received her warmly and invited her for tea. Their connection grew into a comfortable friendship, with [Anne](../character/anne.md) regularly visiting him on his porch to discuss her teaching philosophies and community affairs.

- Friend of — neighbors who became friends over tea and cake  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P39](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0039), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P31](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0031)</sub>

### [Emily](../character/emily.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/emily--harrison.md)

[Emily](../character/emily.md) is Harrison's wife, from whom he was previously separated. As Harrison explained to [Anne](../character/anne.md), their marital rift originally stemmed from disagreements over his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and personal housecleaning habits. The pair eventually reconciled, with [Emily](../character/emily.md) returning home and warmly receiving [Anne](../character/anne.md) upon her arrival.

- Spouse of — married  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P47](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0047), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P9](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0009), +2 more</sub>
